section_summary.extract_value: This section describes translation/back-translation of the BAS-2 into Persian and ethical approval, followed by data collection from December 2014 to June 2015 at seven universities in Tehran. University students were approached in classroom settings and completed a paper-and-pencil questionnaire (BAS-2 counterbalanced with other measures); participation was voluntary and unremunerated. The section does not number studies (no 'Study 1' etc.), does not report sample size, age, BMI, race/ethnicity, or correlations.
